query:
UPDATE achievements
SET sageEnrichment = 'Covered in Sage session summary: Amanda demonstrates a consistent drive to identify structural problems and redesign them into logical, coherent solutions. Language and communication are central — she thinks out loud, values intellectual stimulation and the company of equals, and finds deep satisfaction in being understood. She is energised by independence and setting her own agenda, and finds fulfilment in seeing tangible real-world impact from her work.'
WHERE clientId = 1149902
AND (sageEnrichment IS NULL OR sageEnrichment = '');
